question: Ano ang mga requirements para makakuha ng Occupancy Permit kapag tapos na ang construction ng building?
answer:
To obtain an Occupancy Permit after construction of a building is complete, the following requirements must be submitted:

1. Application Letter [S1]
2. The corresponding fees for the Occupancy Permit, which are based on the character of occupancy or use of the building/structure, cost of construction, and floor area. The fees can be found in the Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) [S2].
3. A Sidewalk Enclosure, if applicable, as a Sidewalk Enclosure and Occupancy Permit is required prior to or during the processing of the building permit or before any enclosure is made [S3].

The exact fees for the Occupancy Permit can be found in Table II.G.1 of the Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) [S2]. The Office of the City Building Official (OCBO) is responsible for issuing the Occupancy Permit [S1, S3].

ground_truth:
Occupancy checklist: application letter (1 original); authorization letter if applicant is not owner (1 original); owner ID with 3 specimen signatures (1 photocopy); Certificate of Occupancy (1 original); Certificate of Completion (1 original); BFP Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (1 original); four-elevation project pictures (front/back/left/right); approved Building Construction, Architectural, Civil/Structural, Sanitary/Plumbing, Electrical and Mechanical installation permits (1 photocopy); approved building-permit plan (1 original).

If a different professional undertook/was assigned the project, the checklist requires a signed, notarized waiver from the previous professional in charge (1 original). It also lists Structure Images with CAAP clearance and structural survey for actual building height, signed/sealed by a licensed Geodetic Engineer. The authorization-letter source cell says CPDO and the picture source cell says Hired Geodetic Engineer; those unusual source associations are preserved.
